markPaid.title: Bank transfer confirmation
markPaid.awaitingBody: The order stays <0>pending</0> until a different finance user checks the bank statement and approves this request. Approving applies the capture (escrow, receipt, booking); rejecting discards it.
markPaid.sameUser: You recorded this request, so you cannot approve it (maker-checker). Ask another finance user to approve it; you can still reject it if it was entered by mistake.
markPaid.approveBody: Confirm that <0>{{amount}}</0> with reference <1>{{reference}}</1> has been credited to the platform bank account. The order is captured and posted to the ledger; this cannot be undone except by a refund.
markPaid.rejected: Mark-paid request rejected; the order stays pending
markPaid.rejectBody: The order stays pending and nothing is posted. A finance user can record a new request once the transfer is confirmed.

amount.returningNote: A full return was started but the gateway did not confirm it. Retry the return (it is idempotent).

accept.title: Accept the received amount
accept.explain: The payment is captured for the amount actually received and applied pro rata: the booking is credited with that amount only, and the remaining balance stays due from the patient.

return.title: Return the payment in full
return.explain: The whole payment is refunded to the payer through the gateway. Nothing is posted to the books and the order stays unpaid, so the patient has to pay the correct amount again.

refundThreshold.title: Dual approval
refundThreshold.every: Every refund must be approved by a finance user other than the one who requested it.
refundThreshold.above: Refunds above <0>{{amount}}</0> (converted to INR) must be approved by a finance user other than the one who requested them. Smaller refunds can be approved by the requester.
refundThreshold.defaultSetting: Default threshold; finance can change it in <0>Settings</0>.

payoutFailure.reversed: Payout reversed; its items are eligible again
payoutFailure.reversalEffect: The payout becomes reversed, its ledger posting is reversed and its items return to eligible for the next batch.
payoutFailure.failureEffect: The payout fails and its items return to eligible for the next batch.

generate.periodEndHint: Include items that became eligible on or before this date
generate.periodEndFuture: Period end cannot be in the future

payoutPaid.labelReconcile: Razorpay transfer id (trf_…) or bank UTR
payoutPaid.label: UTR / bank reference
payoutPaid.recorded: Reference recorded; a second finance user must confirm the payout
payoutPaid.failed: Could not mark the payout paid
payoutPaid.unknownBody: The transfer call timed out or returned an unclear answer, so it was not retried. Search the Razorpay dashboard (Route → Transfers) for this payout id (<0>notes.payout_id</0>). If the transfer exists, enter its <1>trf_…</1> id here; a different finance user then confirms it. If it does not exist, use <2>Request failure</2> instead so the items are batched again.
payoutPaid.body: Enter the UTR from the bank transfer. This records it only: a different finance user must confirm it before the payout is posted to the ledger (payee payable → bank).

payoutFail.referenceRequired: A bank return or gateway reference (at least 3 characters) is required
payoutFail.requested: Failure requested; a different finance user must approve it
payoutFail.marked: Payout marked as failed; its items are eligible again
payoutFail.serverReferenceRequired: A bank or gateway reference is required to fail this payout
payoutFail.failed: Could not mark the payout failed
payoutFail.dualProcessed: This payout was already marked paid, so money may have left the platform. Record the bank return (bounce) reference; a different finance user must then approve the request before the payout is reversed and its items return to eligible.
payoutFail.dualUnknown: The gateway outcome of this payout is unknown, so money may have left the platform. Record the reference that proves no transfer was made (e.g. the Razorpay dashboard search); a different finance user must then approve the request before the payout fails and its items return to eligible.
payoutFail.immediate: No money has been sent for this payout yet, so it fails immediately and its items return to eligible for the next batch.
payoutFail.referenceHint: Bank return reference, gateway case id, etc.

markPaid.requestOnly: This records a request only. The order is captured when a different finance user approves it.

orders.emptyDescription: Orders appear when patients or agents start a checkout.

payments.emptyDescription: Payment attempts appear when the payer completes (or abandons) a checkout.

overview.title: Finance overview
overview.description: Platform money position from the double-entry ledger (base currency INR). Balances update as payments, revenue recognition, refunds and payouts are posted.

stats.escrowHint: Captured patient money held until treatment completes
stats.gatewayReceivableHint: Captured but not yet swept to the bank by the gateway
stats.hospitalPayablesHint: Owed to hospitals after commission, GST and TDS
stats.pendingSettlementsHint: Net of settlement items not yet paid out

flow.title: How money flows
flow.capture: A patient pays through the gateway (or bank transfer). Dr gateway receivable / Cr patient escrow; gateway fees are expensed against the receivable.
flow.revenue: When the hospital marks the booking completed, escrow is released: hospital payable (net), commission revenue, GST output, TDS 194-O and service-fee revenue. Agent commission is expensed to the agent payable.
flow.settlement: Items become eligible after the hold period. Finance generates a batch, a different finance user approves it (maker-checker), then it is processed into payouts (Razorpay Route, manual transfer with UTR, or mock).
flow.payout: A processed payout debits the payee payable and credits bank. The daily sweep moves settled gateway funds from receivable to bank. Refunds before completion reverse escrow against the receivable.

latest.title: Latest payment orders
latest.emptyDescription: Orders appear when patients start a checkout.

reconciliation.title: Bank transfer reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Match each uploaded proof against the bank statement and record it with the bank reference. A second finance user approves the request before the order is captured.

pending.emptyDescription: All submitted bank transfers have been processed.

reconciliation.caption: Bank transfers: {{queue}}

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.description: Refund requests are approved before the gateway refund is issued: requested → approved → processing → processed.
refunds.blockedTitle: You requested this refund and it is above {{amount}}: a different finance user must approve it
refunds.emptyDescription: Refunds requested by finance or admins (or created by cancellations) appear here.
refunds.approved: Refund approved; the gateway refund has been queued
refunds.approveBody: Refund <0>{{amount}}</0> on order <1>{{order}}</1> to the original payment method. This cannot be undone once the gateway processes it.

refundPayout.confirmed: Payout confirmed; the refund is processed

tax_remittance.help: GST / TDS paid to the government: debit TAX:* accounts, credit PLATFORM:BANK.

fx_difference.label: FX difference
fx_difference.help: Must use PLATFORM:FX_GAIN_LOSS (debit = loss, credit = gain) against escrow, bank or a gateway receivable.

manual.label: Manual correction
manual.help: Must use PLATFORM:ADJUSTMENTS (expense) or PLATFORM:EQUITY (capital in/out). Payee payables cannot be adjusted here.

adjustments.permanent: Posting is permanent; corrections need a new adjustment.

batches.title: Settlement batches
batches.description: Batches move from pending approval to approved (by a different finance user), processing and completed. Automatic batches always need a human approver.
batches.emptyDescription: Generate a batch from eligible settlement items, or wait for the daily automatic batch.

batchDetail.title: Settlement batch
batchDetail.descriptionSinglePeriod: {{type}} settlement for a single payee, period ending {{date}}
batchDetail.descriptionAllPeriod: {{type}} settlement for all payees, period ending {{date}}
batchDetail.makerTitle: You created this batch; a different finance user must approve it.
batchDetail.makerCheckerBody: You generated this batch, so you cannot approve it. Ask another finance or super-admin user to review and approve it. You can still reject it.
batchDetail.autoBody: The daily settlement job generated this batch. Automatic batches are never auto-approved: a finance user must check the items and payees, then approve (or reject) it before payouts can be processed.
batchDetail.partialBody: Failed payouts return their items to eligible: fix the cause (for example the payee's payout account), then generate a new batch for them. A payout that failed with “payout account changed” was blocked because the payee's account differed from the one approved in this batch.

destinations.title: Payout destinations (frozen at generation)
destinations.body: These are the verified primary payout accounts captured when the batch was generated; approving the batch approves paying them. If a payee's account is changed before payouts run, that payee's payout fails with “payout account changed” and its items return to eligible to be batched again with the new account.
destinations.noSnapshot: This batch has no account snapshot (generated before destination snapshots were introduced). Check each payee's verified account on the Payout accounts page before approving.
destinations.missing_one: One payee had no verified primary payout account at generation; their payouts will fail.
destinations.missing_other: {{count}} payees had no verified primary payout account at generation; their payouts will fail.

batchDetail.noPayoutsDescription: Payouts are created when an approved batch is processed.
batchDetail.approveBodyNoAccounts: You are approving <0>{{items}}</0> items with a net payable of <1>{{net}}</1> to the payees' payout accounts. Check the items, totals and accounts before approving.
batchDetail.approveBodyOneAccount: You are approving <0>{{items}}</0> items with a net payable of <1>{{net}}</1> to the payout account shown under “Payout destinations”. Check the items, totals and accounts before approving.
batchDetail.approveBodyAccounts: You are approving <0>{{items}}</0> items with a net payable of <1>{{net}}</1> to the {{accounts}} payout accounts shown under “Payout destinations”. Check the items, totals and accounts before approving.
batchDetail.missingWarning_one: {{count}} payee(s) have no verified account; their payouts will fail.
batchDetail.missingWarning_other: {{count}} payee(s) have no verified account; their payouts will fail.
batchDetail.processBody: This creates payouts for <0>{{net}}</0>: linked Razorpay accounts are paid automatically; manual bank transfers wait for you to enter the UTR.
batchDetail.rejectDescription: Items return to the eligible pool and can be batched again.

snapshot.missing: No verified primary payout account: this payee's payout will fail.

payouts.description: Payouts created from processed batches. A manual bank transfer stays open until one finance user records the UTR and a different finance user confirms it.

reconcile.emptyDescription: Payouts whose gateway outcome is unknown (timeouts, unclear answers) appear here. They are never re-sent automatically.

confirm.emptyDescription: UTRs recorded by one finance user appear here for a second user to confirm.

reversal.emptyDescription: Requests to fail a paid-out or unreconciled payout wait here for a second finance user.

payouts.reconcileBody: The Razorpay Route call for these payouts timed out or returned an unclear answer, so the platform did not retry it (a retry could pay twice). Search the Razorpay dashboard for the payout id. If the transfer exists, use <0>Record transfer</0> with its <1>trf_…</1> id and have a second finance user confirm it. If it does not, use <2>Request failure</2> with the reference you checked; after a second finance user approves, the items return to eligible and are batched again.
payouts.emptyDescription: Payouts are created when an approved settlement batch is processed.

documents.description: Commission tax invoices and credit notes issued to hospitals, and commission statements for agents. Credit notes reverse commission on clawed-back items.
